hooks.command: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .) && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l 'TODO\|FIXME\|HACK' 2>/dev/null && echo '[Hook] 变更中包含 TODO/FIXME/HACK，完成后请处理' || true
cd $PROJECT_DIR && git diff --name-only HEAD~1 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l 'TODO\|FIXME\|HACK' 2>/dev/null && echo '[Hook] 警告：变更中包含 TODO/FIXME/HACK' || echo '[Hook] 审查完成，未发现未完成标记'
